sentences.text: Chitra vs The State Represented By The Inspector ... on 14

August, 2024
Author: Sudhanshu Dhulia
Bench: Sudhanshu Dhulia
 Item No.16 Court No.16 Section Ii
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings
 Petition(s) for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) Nos.10725-10726/2024
 (Arising out of impugned final judgment and orders dated 09-07-2024
 in Crlop No. 15975/2024 & Crlmp No. 9754/2024 passed by the High
 Court Of Judicature At Madras)
 Chitra Petitioner
 Versus
 The State Represented By The Inspector Of
 Police & Anr. Respondent
 ( Ia No.175220/2024-EXEMPTION From Filing C/C Of The Impugned
 Judgment and Ia No.175223/2024-EXEMPTION From Filing O.T. )
 Date : 14-08-2024 These petitions were called on for hearing today.
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Gaurav Agrawal, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Gautam Jha, Aor
 Mr. Pankaj Kumar, Adv.
 Mr. M. Kannadasan, Adv.
 Mr. Amol Shivalkar, Adv.
 For Respondent(s)
 Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R
The petitioner seeks quashing of proceedings in connection with the Fir No. 05/2024 for the
offences punishable under Sections 406, 465, 467, 468, 471, 420 & 506(1) of the Indian Penal Code.
We see ab
solutely no reason to interfere with the ongoing investigation.
This case(s) does not call for interference, in exercise of our jurisdiction under Article 136 of the Constitution of India.
The present petitions are, accordingly, dismissed along with pending application(s), if any.
